newsitem.title: UK: Core details Scott Pickford acceptances.
newsitem.headline: Core details Scott Pickford acceptances.

text.p: U.S-based laboratory services group Core Laboratories NV said on Monday it had acceptances for 47.56 percent of the issued share capital of British geoscience service company Scott Pickford Plc.
Core and Australia's Aerodata Holdings are fighting for control of Scott Pickford.
Core Laboratories said it had written confirmation from Scott Pickford shareholders with 32.57 percent of the company's share capital that they intended to accept the offer.

In addition, shareholders representing 14.99 percent of the company said they would accept the offer. Core Laboratories said the acceptances were legally binding but would cease to be effective if a third party made an offer above 57p per share.
Core Laboratories' initial offer, launched in early January, was at 53p per share but it raised its bid to 57p last week.
Its rival Aerodata has already built up a 21.5 percent stake in Scott Pickford.
